items.lede: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device […]
items.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work

items.lede: Perplexity launches personal AI agents that can act as your 'teammates.'
items.title: Perplexity's 'teammates' are the company's AI agents for daily work tasks
